issue: After the Comptroller upgrade of Compound Proposal 62 (`CompRewards.upgrade`), accounts that held a position before the upgrade in a market that never had COMP rewards are credited COMP that was never emitted. Example, from mainnet: in cSUSHI both reward indices were 0 and the COMP speed was 0. A borrower with 18977306140567618322762 borrow units and no recorded borrower index claims 139 blocks after the upgrade, with both speeds still 0, and `CompRewards.comptroller` pays it 18977306140567618322762 (18,977.31 COMP). On mainnet this is transaction 0xc9244e5349f49f3b74a54a882e71f1ca11ba14ed74f73bf2cd091ed8be2b0001, block 13322937, 2021-09-29. Nothing was emitted to that market, so nothing should have been paid.

source.function: Comptroller.updateCompSupplyIndex, updateCompBorrowIndex, distributeSupplierComp, distributeBorrowerComp, claimComp, grantCompInternal, setCompSpeedInternal, _upgradeSplitCompRewards (contracts/Comptroller.sol)

vulnerable.lines: contracts/Comptroller.sol line 1217 (distributeSupplierComp) and line 1256 (distributeBorrowerComp): `supplierIndex == 0 && supplyIndex > compInitialIndex`
vulnerable.verification: Sourcify exact match (runtime and creation bytecode); contracts/Comptroller.sol sha256 ec97bebc1c045bbbc2da36d42b079336e28d5f187524f88c29b3e00b10895e16, byte-identical to the file at the commit

fix.proposal: Compound Proposal 64, executed at block 13382885 (2021-10-09T06:16:06Z); Proposal 65 at block 13449598 (2021-10-19T17:50:24Z) kept the distribution and removed the claim lock
